reasons: The cited § 6 MFN runs in the Customer's favour (TrueLink may not charge Client more than any other party, plus a one-year price freeze), which is exactly the preferred position under rule MFN.
No Client-side obligation to extend or match third-party terms is identified, so there is no deviation to raise.
Consistent with a compliant finding, the redline is unchanged and no comment was added; the rationale accurately cites the paragraph and explains why the Vendor-granted MFN is left intact.
